candidates.explanation: When the update DTO has no photo (undefined, e.g. only first name edited), the code sets photo = null instead of leaving it undefined. The mapper turns null into photo = null and the persistence layer clears the photo relation, so the avatar disappears. It should be `else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`, as in create().

fix.description: Change the condition so only an explicit null clears the photo; undefined leaves it unchanged.
